description: Create the tracker issue AND start the run in one call, for work that has no issue yet. Pass entryStartAt='builder' with an entryPlan to hand over a plan you already wrote; pass entryStartAt='reviewer'/'qa' with entryPrNumber to hand over an existing build — in which case title may be omitted and the pull request's own title names the mission. For the first mission of a SHIP Sites project, pass starter (website, blog, docs or waitlist) and site, the shared form, in place of title and description: SHIP writes the issue, or a mission with no issue on a project SHIP made with Start from scratch, and holds the site address. Read list_site_starters first. This tool calls the SHIP API, documented at https://letsship.ai/docs/api. Requires the missions:run token scope.

agents.description: Per-role harness/model override for THIS mission only; overrides ship.yml without changing it

description.description: Issue body; acceptance criteria written here are parsed as they would be on any issue

entryPrNumber.description: Existing open PR number, required for entryStartAt='reviewer' or 'qa'

entryStartAt.description: Pipeline stage to enter at; omit for the default full run starting at the planner

projectId.description: Project id the mission belongs to

site.description: The form of a site starter. Required with starter; leave out title, description, labels and entry

about.description: website, blog and waitlist: the three answers every founder gives first. Ask the person all three. The other facts of the kind are optional

description.description: What the business does and for whom, in the person's words: 10 to 2000 characters

location.description: Where the business is, in the person's words: a town, an address, or online

name.description: The name of the business, 2 to 60 characters

author.description: blog, optional: the author of the first post. Without it, the business

brand.description: Where the brand comes from (one of three sources)

brandName.description: 2 to 60 characters, for the sources logo and preset. With about, send about.name

logo.description: The logo file, for the brand source logo

data.description: The file, base64-encoded, up to 2 MB

presetId.description: A preset id from list_brand_presets, for the source preset

source.description: website: SHIP captures the brand from websiteUrl. logo: from logo. preset: one of list_brand_presets

websiteUrl.description: An https URL that answers, for the source website

brandRights.description: The confirmation of the person the token acts for: they own this brand or have the right to use it. Send it only when that person confirmed the text that list_site_starters gives.

business.description: website: the optional answers of a type of business. list_site_starters gives each type and its questions. Send only the answers the type asks, and only those the person gave: the starter site leaves out a section with no answer

address.description: local-business, restaurant, appointments, events: the street, the postcode and the town

appStoreUrl.description: app: an https URL of the app on the App Store

bookingUrl.description: local-business, restaurant, appointments, coach: an https URL where customers book

email.description: portfolio: the email address where people ask for work

events.description: events: one to twelve dates, each YYYY-MM-DD, the time, then the name, the place and the price, such as 2026-11-21 20:30 Jazz night, The Cellar, €18

googlePlayUrl.description: app: an https URL of the app on Google Play

hours.description: local-business, restaurant, appointments: one to seven groups of days, each the days then the hours, such as Monday to Friday 08:00 to 18:00 or Sunday: closed

menu.description: restaurant: one to twelve dishes, each the name then the price with its currency, such as Tomato soup €7

orderUrl.description: restaurant: an https URL where guests order to take away or for delivery

phone.description: local-business, restaurant, appointments: the phone number customers call

prices.description: local-business: one to eight prices, each the name then the price with its currency, such as Brake service €25

products.description: shop: one to eight products, each the name then the price with its currency, such as Stoneware mug €24

services.description: appointments, coach: one to ten services, each the name, the time if given, then the price with its currency, such as Haircut 30 min €25

shopUrl.description: shop: an https URL where people buy

ticketsUrl.description: events: an https URL where people buy tickets

type.description: A type from businessTypes of list_site_starters

work.description: portfolio: one to six kinds of work, one for each line, such as Posters

language.description: The language of the site's words, from languages of list_site_starters. Without it, English

outline.description: docs: three to seven page titles

product.description: waitlist, optional: what people join the waitlist for. Without it, the business. Only a project SHIP made with Start from scratch takes a waitlist

productWebsite.description: docs: the product website, an https URL

slug.description: The site address: https://<slug>.letsship.app, 3 to 40 of a-z, 0-9 and hyphens

topic.description: blog, optional: the topic of the first post. Without it, the business

starter.description: The first mission of a SHIP Sites project of this kind; needs site

title.description: Issue title. Omit ONLY with entryPrNumber — the pull request's own title is then used

name: create_mission
title: Create a mission
